verdict.rationale: The UCP/AP2 layer says agents transact within "pre-defined, verifiable boundaries" using cryptographically signed payment authorizations tied to cart state. Shopify gates complete_checkout behind Token-tier permission, and its JWTs carry a 60-minute TTL. However, the rate limits are platform-assigned by trust tier rather than user-set caps, and nothing documents configurable per-agent spend limits or an instant revocation control. missing for 10: user-configurable per-agent spend caps, user-set usage limits, a documented instant revocation mechanism for payment authority, hands-on or independent corroboration.
